defects.description: Description: lean one hand flat against its surface (mirror in front of body, z+ direction). Currently L wrist at (-0.854, 0.323, 0.181) — far to LEFT of body (x=-0.854, ~3x shoulder x), z=0.181 only slightly forward. Hand is extended far outward not forward against mirror. shoulderFwdL=-1 (essentially zero forward flexion) — L arm points outward not forward.
Description: Pop the opposite hip out to the side for an editorial curve. hips=10 too subtle for editorial-curve hip pop.

failing_tests.assertion: L wrist z > 0.30 and |x| < 0.40 for hand-flat-on-mirror-in-front
failing_tests.actual: z=0.181, x=-0.854 (arm extended outward not forward)

failing_tests.assertion: hips magnitude >=18 for editorial-curve hip pop

regression_risk: medium — shoulderFwdL=-70 is large magnitude; may interact with leftShoulder=-15 producing L wrist position offset from ideal mirror target. Integrator should verify L hand reaches mirror surface (z>0.30, |x|<0.40).
rationale: Four coordinated changes for L-hand-on-mirror posture. Per CORRECTED sign convention shoulderFwd -=forward. (1) leftShoulder -40→-15: reduce outward abduction (was 75deg, arm flung leftward); new value ~30deg abduction keeps arm closer to body. (2) shoulderFwdL -1→-70: significant forward flexion to bring L arm IN FRONT of body (z+ direction) reaching mirror surface. (3) leftElbow 40→15: nearly straight elbow for hand-flat (not fist) posture. (4) hips 10→20: stronger hip-pop magnitude for editorial curve. Right arm + legs unchanged. Spine=15, neck=-8.8 preserved.
